title: GIG-3189: Gate Password Rotation With Rotate Database Password Flag
description: Produce skips ALTER ROLE and op item edit unless ROTATE_DATABASE_PASSWORD is true, so factory can leave rotation off until the 1Password service account has write access.

steps: Confirm environmentAllowsRotation is false for false/0/off and true for true/1/empty
Confirm the generated produce workflow passes ROTATE_DATABASE_PASSWORD
